evals.prompt: What is the command to run my agent eval suites in evals/suites locally against the deepseek-v4-flash model profile with the agentware runner, on a shared model server? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.

evals.expected_output: No. Exit 2 means the endpoint was unreachable or the run was misconfigured (e.g. EVAL_*_BASE_URL unset); it is never scored. Exit 1 is below threshold.

says exit 1 is the below-threshold result

evals.prompt: Our pull requests run the agent-evals CI gate. At what pass rate does the check fail, and where do I see the results? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.
evals.expected_output: Any suite below 95% on any model profile fails; results appear in one sticky PR comment with a suite × model table.

evals.prompt: My eval suite has "repeats": 3 and one case passed on 2 of the 3 repeats. Does that case pass? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.
evals.expected_output: No. A case passes only if every repeat passes.
